The legend, defined by the letter Z®
It’s been a revolution since 1969 — now reborn as the available Z32-inspired Heritage
Edition, a limited-edition package exclusively in Midnight Purple. The 400-hp1 twin-
turbo V6 pairs with a precision 6-speed manual and balanced rear-wheel drive to
deliver responsive, reliable performance — engineered for durability. Wrapped in a
striking body and a meticulously crafted, driver-focused cockpit, it’s a pure sports
car the way only a Z can be.
Nissan Z® Performance shown in Black Diamond Pearl.

from the snug-yet-supple grip that keeps you in control to the retro-futuristic

bliss only a Z can offer. It’s the perfect balance between advanced technology
that responds to voice and touch, seamless smartphone integration,2 and iconic
interior design that defines what a classic sports car should be.

pages.text:
®
Z® NISMO® — the apex predator
Developed by the legendary motorsports arm of Nissan, the Z NISMO rattles the cages of the
competition with a track-tuned 420-hp engine,1 enhanced 9-speed automatic transmission, and
unique Sport+ Drive Mode for incredible response.8
Aerodynamics learned at the track make their way to the street. A unique honeycomb grille enhances
engine cooling, while front canard wing vortex generators, wider sill side spoilers, rear air splitters,
and a unique rear spoiler all help provide additional downforce.8
Putting power to the pavement is a NISMO-tuned suspension featuring larger-diameter shocks
and higher spring rates, massive Akebono® brakes with larger 15" rotors, and wider 19" lightweight
RAYS® forged-alloy wheels wrapped in special Dunlop® tires.
Inside, it is as beautiful and sports-inspired as it is focused, with Recaro® seats, an Alcantara®-
wrapped steering wheel with a red leather stripe at 12 o’clock, and a unique instrument
display on the digital dash.
